description: The figure contains three side-by-side grouped bar charts labeled (a) WikiText, (b) PTB, and (c) C4, illustrating the perplexity of an LLaMA1-7B model across different validation datasets under varying quantization bit settings for two methods shown in the legend: “Uniform” (blue bars) and “Ours” (orange bars). In each subplot, the horizontal axis contains the category “Quantization Bits” with four ordered tick labels increasing from left to right (3, 4, 8, 16), and the vertical axis is labeled “Perplexity” and uses a linear scale; in (a) and (c) the plotted range extends a bit above 30 with regularly spaced tick labels at about 5-unit intervals, while in (b) the range extends to roughly 450 with tick labels spaced about every 50 units. For (a) WikiText, each quantization bit value has a pair of adjacent bars: Uniform is approximately 30.5 at 3 bits, ~27.0 at 4 bits, ~26.5 at 8 bits, and ~26.6 at 16 bits, while Ours is approximately ~21.6 at 3 bits, ~18.9 at 4 bits, ~18.3 at 8 bits, and ~18.3 at 16 bits. For (b) PTB, Uniform is approximately ~420 at 3 bits, ~315 at 4 bits, ~298 at 8 bits, and ~299 at 16 bits, while Ours is approximately ~244 at 3 bits, ~177 at 4 bits, ~182 at 8 bits, and ~182 at 16 bits. For (c) C4, Uniform is approximately ~29.6 at 3 bits, ~25.0 at 4 bits, ~24.6 at 8 bits, and ~24.6 at 16 bits, while Ours is approximately ~20.6 at 3 bits, ~18.1 at 4 bits, ~17.7 at 8 bits, and ~17.7 at 16 bits. The bars are arranged as consistent two-bar groups per bit value (blue then orange), the bit categories appear in ascending numeric order rather than being sorted by bar height, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with special shading, outlines, or annotations beyond the subplot titles and legends.
